items.title: Prato: Arroz branco cozido + Salmão grelhado + Agrião
items.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative meal photograph for a nutrition recipe catalog. Primary request: a realistic appetizing serving containing ONLY these named catalog foods (names in Brazilian Portuguese): Arroz branco cozido; Salmão grelhado; Agrião. Atum fresco grelhado is fully cooked grilled tuna: opaque beige-tan flaky muscle chunks with browned edges, no pink or red center, no rare sliced steaks.
